body:
## 缺陷

`ElDrawer`（`direction="ltr"`）在 landscape-notch safe-area profile 下，其交互子元素（含内部 `el-drawer__close-btn` 与消费者内容链接）被量测到负 left 坐标——位于 safe rect 左缘（inset 59px）之外，甚至整个视口左缘之外。Chromium 与 WebKit 均复现，偏移量不同，疑似隐藏态 transform 驻留或 safe-area inset 未参与面板几何。

## 复现证据（消费者 FsusBlog 真实渲染验收）

- 环境：FsusBlog UX viewport 验收 safe-area 矩阵（真实后端 + 生产构建）
- 用例：`user-profile` → `account-drawer` → `landscape-notch`（844×390，insets left 59 / right 59 / bottom 21）→ `light`
- safe rect：`{"left":59,"top":0,"right":785,"bottom":369}`
- Chromium 违规示例：`el-drawer__close-btn` `left=-71.46 right=-17.46`；`account-module-link` `left=-288.46 right=-17.46`
- WebKit 违规示例：`account-module-link` `left=-84.31 right=186.69`
- 消费者 drawer 用法：`direction="ltr"`、`size="min(86vw, 22rem)"`、自定义 header slot——均为公开 props，无内部选择器覆盖

## 期望

drawer 面板及其交互内容在 landscape-notch 下完整落在 safe rect 内；关闭/隐藏态不应对验收暴露可交互、可量测的越界几何（如需要 `visibility`/`inert` 语义请按组件契约处理）。

## 范围边界

- FsusUI 面板几何/safe-area 处理缺陷；若裁定消费者 `size` 需收缩也请在 FsusUI 契约层面说明（公开 prop 语义）
- 消费者侧 issue：Ozwasyd/FsusBlog#3475
- FsusUI 基线：`f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864`

comments.body: WIP: implementing #827 on isolated branch `fix/issue-827-drawer-safe-interaction` from freshly fetched main `f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864`. Scope is Drawer geometry and hidden interaction semantics using the existing canonical safe-area helpers and public size/direction API. Shared focus-trap/use-dialog source is reserved for #826 and will remain untouched here. Consumer coordination: Blog viewport owner original2228 should reuse the eventual Drawer source SHA through the real local alias, especially account-drawer / landscape-notch (844×390, left/right 59, bottom 21), positive boxes and actual hit testing. Fresh Blog master fetched: `0a755584aa256995fd9997ca974806e8a0e29d2e`. Saved environment currently lacks an initialized backend schema plus legitimate current-schema admission receipt, so consumer runtime acceptance remains OPEN; no admission bypass or package publication is planned. This is an implementation notice, not acceptance evidence.

WIP implementation draft: https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusUI/pull/853

Source SHA `6d7d1cf50fc7622690003db4956398fb7d130fb2`, branch `fix/issue-827-drawer-safe-interaction`, fresh main `f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864`. Fresh default-branch conflict check exits 0; GitHub reports MERGEABLE and the PR remains draft. No default-branch push or merge.

Drawer now marks closing/hidden content inert and aria-hidden while preserving the original leave animation. Reopening removes these attributes; retained/destroy-on-close and before-close cancellation are covered. Landscape direction regressions also exposed top/bottom close controls at right=819; the existing canonical inset helper now keeps them at right=784. No focus-trap/use-dialog edit, consumer CSS workaround, new token, or duplicate kernel.

Actual final checks: focused Drawer/Dialog/focus-trap/viewport contract unit suite 70/70; Chromium source fixture 10/10; compiled production fixture 10/10, with all eight direction/theme screenshots inspected. The reported ltr/min(86vw,22rem) case has close box left=273/right=327/top=17/bottom=71 (54×54), and account link left=60/right=327/top=61.796875/bottom=105.796875 (267×44); both real elementFromPoint hit tests succeed. Closing is inert/aria-hidden and blocks hit testing/programmatic focus while the leave transition is still rendered. Retained terminal content has zero client rects.

Lint, theme build, isolated production build, viewport/design/token/documentation/skill checks pass. Broad web typecheck FAILS with 1,023 diagnostics identical to fresh main in the saved environment. The standard affected-visual gate FAILS strict runtime readiness because the icon producer changes source fingerprints; its unrelated generated additions were recorded and restored. Current GitHub checks are queued/skipped; no remote pass is claimed.

Consumer coordination for original2228: fresh Blog master `53da546cc8ab9fd8603067395d988b7ddb650394` passes the real local-alias typecheck and its account frame resolves ElDrawer to this FsusUI source. Reuse this exact source SHA and the public `opened` event for settled geometry. The original slide animation still moves during opening; the existing documented background remains edge-attached and is distinct from the safe content rectangle. These source-fixture results do not substitute for the real user-profile route.

Keep #827 OPEN. WebKit assertions remain UNRUN because launch validation requires system-cache libGLESv2.so.2 and this environment has no sudo capability. Real-backend Blog acceptance remains UNRUN against the saved schema/admission gap; published candidate/device checks and independent UX acceptance remain OPEN. A schema-valid rejected UX receipt records these blockers. No admission/CSP/security controls were weakened, no package published, and no credentials/App grants created.

Integration checkpoint for #827:

- Canonical Drawer implementation remains frozen at `6d7d1cf50fc7622690003db4956398fb7d130fb2`, draft PR https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusUI/pull/853. No rewrite or merge.
- Consumed supplied canonical icon commit `7d9de0259f26eb87ac102ca4ceddc2918ff7890a` with `git cherry-pick -x` on distinct published branch `integration/issue-827-with-icon-842`, head `da92f60c1f186057eeee4f2a6858fe5e82e70566`. Its icon index blob is exactly the original canonical blob `a9b48d07bda97064ea2f24c59988e16af4b5e963`. Drawer source is unchanged; no duplicate fix.
- Exact integration commands/results: focused Drawer/Dialog/focus-trap/viewport unit command 70/70; Chromium safe-area Drawer spec 10/10; real Blog local-alias typecheck PASS on latest fetched Blog master `0e9dd5751bdd584204fd149bdb1526b97ff682a6`; `pnpm run lint` PASS.
- `FSUS_VISUAL_BASE=origin/main pnpm run verify:visual:affected` PASS, 8/8, actual ElDrawer interaction/focus/active audit plus feedback captures on desktop-light/mobile-dark. Explicit base is necessary: the first unbased integration invocation fell back to a five-test smoke plan; that smoke pass is not Drawer affected qualification.
- Repeated `pnpm run visual:prepare` PASS: icons/WASM/demo fingerprints match, ready manifest, clean tree. The former readiness blocker is resolved only in this compatible integration source, not retrospectively on the frozen PR.
- Integration `pnpm run typecheck:web:no-cache` still FAILS, exit 2, 1,023 diagnostics identical to recorded fresh-main diagnostics. It is not a pass or an environmental waiver.
- Fresh default conflict checks PASS: UI main `f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864`, integration merge tree `f5cc710c91325b0b537ebbb18e4e0c4d8d5fa3b8`; Blog master `0e9dd5751bdd584204fd149bdb1526b97ff682a6`, merge tree `69dbed36eb81c106e90c82611e2b90b0cb4ca775`.
- Keep #827 OPEN: WebKit assertion execution is still unavailable due system dependency-cache libGLESv2.so.2 and no sudo capability; real-backend Blog schema/admission, published candidate, physical-device and independent acceptance remain open. No CSP/security/failure control weakened, no package publication or merge. Frozen receipts/evidence remain bound to their original SHA and are not inherited as integration acceptance.

# Issue 827: additional integration qualification

PR #853 remains an open draft, frozen at `6d7d1cf50fc7622690003db4956398fb7d130fb2` for the separate root review. No source edits or new source must-fix findings were produced by this check.

The separate integration branch `integration/issue-827-with-icon-842` remains at `da92f60c1f186057eeee4f2a6858fe5e82e70566`. Its Drawer implementation is unchanged from the frozen PR; it additionally consumes the canonical issue #842 icon-export commit.

Additional actual result: **16/16 reduced-motion Chromium source-fixture cases passed**, covering landscape-notch and portrait-notch, light/dark, and all four public directions. Checks include positive control rectangles inside the canonical safe rectangle, `elementFromPoint` hits and real link clicks, Tab containment, Escape, closed inert/aria-hidden state, zero retained client rectangles, and focus return. The exact landscape ltr case used `size="min(86vw, 22rem)"`; settled close box was `(273,17,54,54)` and account-link box was `(60,61.796875,267,44)`, both with successful actual hit tests. These are desktop Chromium public-API fixture results, not physical-device or real Blog runtime evidence.

Raw results: `/workspace/.setup/issue827/reduced-motion-results.json`. Both saved screenshots were visually inspected: `reduced-landscape-notch-light.png` and `reduced-portrait-notch-dark.png`.

Fresh default-branch checks: UI `origin/main=f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864` and Blog `origin/master=0e9dd5751bdd584204fd149bdb1526b97ff682a6`; both merge-tree checks exited zero, with both working trees clean. The real local alias and its ownership remain intact.

Existing exact integration evidence remains in `icon842-integration-outcome.json`: 70/70 focused unit tests, 10/10 Chromium source tests, 8/8 explicit-origin/main affected visual tests, and the fresh Blog alias typecheck passed. UI root typecheck still fails with the same 1023 diagnostics recorded on fresh main. Frozen source evidence and its rejected acceptance receipt remain bound to the frozen SHA and are not inherited by the integration SHA.

Issue #827 acceptance stays OPEN. WebKit assertions remain unrun because Playwright host validation requires system-visible `libGLESv2.so.2`, despite locally extracted libraries; no sudo executable is available. Real Blog runtime lacks an initialized public schema and legitimate current-schema startup admission receipt. Physical-device, published-artifact, Avalonia/full-release, and independent UX acceptance remain unrun. The established background remains edge-attached, and safe control geometry is measured after the original public `opened` event; this does not claim full-panel containment during the preserved opening animation.

No merge, default-branch push, package publication, shared focus-trap edit, private consumer CSS repair, or security/admission bypass was performed.
